name: Methylenedioxydimethylamphetamine
summary: MDDMA, or MDDM, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N,N-dimethylamphetamine or as N,N-dimethyl-MDA or N-methyl-MDMA, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families. It is the N,N-dimethyl analogue of MDA and the N-methyl derivative of MDMA. The drug is a known synthetic impurity of MDMA and has also been described as a possible novel designer drug in 2025.

pharmacology.text: MDDMA shows reduced potency as a monoamine releasing agent and reuptake inhibitor compared to MDA and MDMA. It was 11-fold less potent than MDMA and 4-fold less potent than MDA as a serotonin releasing agent (SRA). Moreover, whereas MDA and MDMA are serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agents (SNDRAs), MDDMA is a selective SRA along with ≥10-fold weaker dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibition.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Psychoactive drug

uses.text: The drug is a known synthetic impurity of MDMA and has also been described as a possible novel designer drug in 2025.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is weaker than MDMA at releasing serotonin, but MDMA-like drugs can cause a faster heart rate, overheating and jaw clenching, with a risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它釋放血清素的能力比 MDMA 弱，但類 MDMA 藥物可能引起心跳加快、體溫過高與咬緊牙關，並有血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它释放血清素的能力比 MDMA 弱，但类 MDMA 药物可能引起心跳加快、体温过高与咬紧牙关，并有血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: MDDM is MDMA with a second methyl group on its nitrogen, and it can turn up as an impurity in illicitly made MDMA.
fact.zh: MDDM 是在 MDMA 的氮原子上再多加一個甲基，它可能以雜質形式出現在非法製造的 MDMA 中。
fact.zhHans: MDDM 是在 MDMA 的氮原子上再多加一个甲基，它可能以杂质形式出现在非法制造的 MDMA 中。
